models.target_initializer: Qwen3.5-4B plus planner V6 SFT checkpoint-100

current_success_step2.rationale: Large target headroom, strong stochastic reward variance, and a fixed larger reference that is not saturated.

fresh_retry_step2.rationale: Central retry action has support and variance, while complete trajectories remain almost entirely unsolved by both models.

post_retry_success_step3.rationale: Needed to complete fresh-retry trajectories after a successful retry; admission is conditional on new Rex support.

control_rationale: These scenarios detect regression toward ending or retrying when the correct policy is migration, and prevent a core-only win from masking state-machine damage.

excluded_from_primary.post_retry_error_step3: Reference is 95.83% while target is 4.17%; use as a migration guardrail, not a short-horizon superiority target.
excluded_from_primary.post_retry_metric_veto_step3: Reference is 95.83% while target is 8.33%, and V7 target-step variance was below 10%.
excluded_from_primary.conflicting_state_step2: Both models are 87.50%; little larger-model separation remains.
excluded_from_primary.nonretryable_step2: Reference is saturated at 100%; retain as a safety control.
excluded_from_primary.budget_exhausted_step2: Reference is saturated at 100%; retain as a safety control.
excluded_from_primary.missing_required_state_step2: Reference is 95.83%; retain as a missing-state safety control.

anti_overfitting_rule: All V8 entities, project names, targets, fixtures, error aliases, and formatted prompt hashes must be new. V7 pilot rows cannot enter V8 training, development, or test.
